comment: Every Mach-O file in a cmux-next app bundle maps to the notices it needs. check_bundle_notices.py fails on a Mach-O that no entry matches and on a missing notice. Requirements: first-party (Contents/Resources/LICENSE), section:<id> (a `<!-- notices-section: <id> -->` marker in Contents/Resources/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md), file:<bundle path> (a non-empty file), ghostty-license-tree:<bundle path> (a Ghostty dependency license tree that verify-ghostty-license-bundle.py accepts), rust-std (each rustc commit named inside the Mach-O is reviewed in cmux-tui/build-support/notices/toolchains/toolchains.json and its COPYRIGHT-library.html is bundled unchanged under Contents/Resources/toolchain-licenses), zig-std (the reviewed Zig LICENSE is bundled unchanged there). Paths are fnmatch patterns relative to the .app; `*` also matches `/`. Add an entry in the same change that adds a binary.

entries.what: the first-party stub executable (App/main.swift) that calls into Contents/Frameworks/CmuxNextApp.framework, where the app's code is (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Package.swift, CMUX-629). A live code build links that code into this binary instead; it is not shipped

the app's code: Swift packages (CmuxNextIcons carries Chromium's vector icons, design/icons/chromium), GhosttyNextKit (static, Zig; its Termio inlines std.math.cbrt, ported from musl), Sparkle client. No Rust: CCmuxAppFFI is Contents/Frameworks/libcmux_app_ffi.dylib, so no rust-std here; Rust that lands in this binary again fails the rustc scan until this entry asks for rust-std
Sparkle framework, Autoupdate and Updater.app
Sentry Cocoa SDK (dynamic; crash and exception reports, cx-urd.58)
ungive/mediaremote-adapter (BSD-3-Clause, vendor/mediaremote-adapter) for Now Playing; loaded by /usr/bin/perl, not linked (scripts/cmux-next/bundle-mediaremote-adapter.sh)

libwebrtc M154 (stasel/WebRTC 154.0.0, Packages/Shared/CmuxVNCWebRTC) for Mac Screen streams (CmuxScreenKit); its BoringSSL, Opus, libvpx, libsrtp, Abseil, dav1d, libaom, libyuv, protobuf-lite and PFFFT notices are in Chromium 154's CREDITS.html
CEF and Chromium, including libcef_sandbox (SwiftShader and the Vulkan loader are not embedded: scripts/cmux-next/embed-cef.sh)
CCmuxAppFFI, the app's Rust library (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-app-ffi, the prebuilt xcframework of app-ffi-pin.json, embedded by Xcode from the dynamic xcframework; rustc std of cmux-tui's toolchain)
first-party CEF shim (links CEF)
first-party CEF helper processes (link CEF)

the remote browser host for the iPhone's browser tabs (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-remote-browser-host, its own Cargo workspace; the pinned prebuilt binary of remote-browser-host.pin.json, embed-remote-browser-host.sh): Rust, a first-party C++ shim and CEF's libcef_dll wrapper; it loads the app's CEF through the symlink Contents/Frameworks/Chromium Embedded Framework.framework

the remote browser host's CEF helper processes (remote-browser-host-layout.sh): cmux-rb-host-helper from build-cef-shim.sh (first-party Objective-C++ and CEF's libcef_dll wrapper, no Rust; cmux#42201), or, when embed-remote-browser-host.sh could not build it, copies of the host binary, which then need the host's notices too (copy_of)

cmux Remote, the pinned team-signed host, Computer Use and Screen Sharing worker that Release builds embed (Packages/macOS/CmuxRemote and the Swift packages it uses; scripts/cmux-next/build-cmux-remote-dev.sh, cmux-remote-dev.pin.json). WebRTC, the cmux Computer Use engine and the screen stream's rules are the three dylibs beside it, not linked in

the same libwebrtc M154 as Contents/Frameworks/WebRTC.framework (stasel/WebRTC 154.0.0), shipped in cmux Remote as a plain dylib (build-cmux-remote-dev.sh); its BoringSSL, Opus, libvpx, libsrtp, Abseil, dav1d, libaom, libyuv, protobuf-lite and PFFFT notices are in Chromium 154's CREDITS.html

the cmux Computer Use engine (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-computer-use-ffi over cmux-computer-use, both MIT, Rust, linked with the first-party cmux-process, GPL-3.0-or-later; build-cmux-remote-dev.sh); its crates are in the cmux-tui workspace that bin/cmux links (cmux-tui depends on cmux-computer-use), and its license is in cmux Remote's Contents/Resources/Licenses

the screen stream's rules for cmux Remote's Screen Sharing worker (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-rd-screen-ffi over cmux-rd-screen, first-party, GPL-3.0-or-later, Rust; build-cmux-remote-dev.sh); the same cmux-rd-screen bin/cmux links through cmux-layout-reducer-ffi, with its serde, serde_json, base64 and p256 dependencies

the Screen Sharing helper (plans/cmux-next/screen-sharing-helper.md): cmux-tui/crates/cmux-rd-host's cmux-rd with only the link feature, the same crates bin/cmux links in for `cmux rd serve` (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-tui depends on cmux-rd-host with default-features = false, features = ["link"]); the name is per channel ("cmux NIGHTLY Helper.app")
the Share extension (scripts/cmux-next/bundle-share-extension.sh): Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/ShareExtension, first-party Swift and the system frameworks only

the cmux CLI and daemon (cmux-tui crates; acpmux, libghostty-vt, the browser host and the app host are linked in, the hosts run by argv[0] as bin/cmux-browser-host and bin/cmux-app-host links; check_ghostty_vt_notices.py checks libghostty-vt's Zig packages)
the same cmux-tui binary for remote hosts
the slim terminal host every macOS terminal runs in (cmux-tui crate cmux-tui, bin cmux-tui-host): the terminal-host runtime of bin/cmux with libghostty-vt, a subset of its crates
the terminal holder that keeps every terminal's PTY (cmux-tui crate cmux-holder, bin cmux-holder): std and libc only, no libghostty-vt

the login-time pre-read (app.backgroundReady = warmAtLogin, off by default; cmux-tui crate cmux-launch-preread, bin cmux-launch-preread): reads the app's code into the page cache at login and exits, std and libc only
app host (cmux-tui crate cmux-app-host)

browser host (cmux-tui crate cmux-browser-host): rquickjs with the QuickJS-NG C engine (Unicode data tables), sha1; embedded runtime JS with acorn and Playwright injected code (js/vendor, browser-host-js.json)

the agent screen-detection plugin the daemon runs by default from beside its own executable (cmux-tui/bindings/examples/rust-agent-screen-detection, its own Cargo workspace; GPL-3.0-or-later AND Apache-2.0): cmux code with the cmux-sdk crate, and detector manifests and sources adapted from herdr (Apache-2.0)
first-party Cloud app server (first-party-apps/cloud/server)
diff viewer sidecar (Native/DiffSidecar)
the Home Chief brain host (Native/OptChat/optchat-chief with optchat-core, optchat-host and cmux-tui's cmux-sdk, cmux-chief, cmux-conversation); cmux-next nightly only
the iPhone connection host that Settings > Mobile runs (cmux-next-ios/rust/crates/cmux-mobile-host with cmux-mobile-link and cmux-tui path crates; build-mobile-host.sh)
Ghostty CLI helper (Zig); the Zig package notices follow in S5
first-party server helper (Swift, no third-party code)

resources.what: Ghostty themes from iTerm2-Color-Schemes (Resources/ghostty/themes, or Ghostty's zig-out share)

Ghostty's shell integration scripts from ghostty-next (bundle-ghostty-resources.sh): bash-preexec 0.7.0 (MIT), Kitty-derived bash/zsh files (GPL-3.0-or-later); rows in cmux-tui/build-support/notices/ghostty/shell-integration.json
Ghostty dependency license tree with the MPL-2.0 source offer (collect-ghostty-licenses.py; nightly-next)
ghostty-next dependency license tree with its MPL-2.0 source offers: the libghostty-vt in bin/cmux (collect-ghostty-licenses.py on the submodule ghostty-vt-sys's build.rs names; nightly-next)
